text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, leave the next destination to me too!
I stayed up late last night perfecting this plan~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Let's make today a fun,
special day!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And that brings us...
To the amusement park!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
First is this spot. The No. 1 popular roller coaster!
Apparently, the hilarious cast members are a big hit too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Actually, I asked my friends for advice on the best route... and this spot was Heart's recommendation.

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's start the warm-up to get hyped, go!
Put your hands up! Say it loud, 'Yeah!'

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yay!!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
More, more! Jump! Smile!
Say!! Yeah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yay!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm not really used to this kind of thing...
so I'm a little embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like it's finally time to get on!
Here I go! Come on, Trainer, you too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's s-so faaaaaastーー!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...T-That was even harder than I expected...!
choice_data_list: N-Next time, anywhere but a roller coaster...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
! R-Right, of course. Um...
Apart from roller coasters, what I'd recommend is...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. If I recall, Messiah-san was—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: If it's that amusement park... how about the haunted house? I went there once with my mother a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh! A-A haunted house...!
Um~ obviously, it's scary, right...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Still, it's not bad every now and then.
To be scared out of your wits to your heart's content, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Because we laid our true feelings bare, I feel like we grew closer... It's an unforgettable memory.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (To make a special memory... yes!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Next... why don't we go to the haunted house!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-s... Trainer-san!
Don't leave my side, not even one millimeter!!
choice_data_list: I'm right here beside you, so try to calm down a little...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: No way, no way! It's completely impossible~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We decided to take a short break after leaving the haunted house.
Leaving the weary Rhein Kraft behind,
I ran off to the concession stand to buy some drinks.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (The haunted house was a mistake. I was the only one making a fuss...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I wanted to make special memories...
but I'm just spinning my wheels...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...No. I shouldn't be making such a gloomy face.
I have to get my head back in the game...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Where to head next…… *yawn*……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... It's 'cause... I went to sleep...
so late... yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd hurried back, but
Rhein Kraft had already fallen asleep.
What should I do now...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Nnh... Hm...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Trainer...?
Did I fall asleep by any chance...!?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry! I was thinking about where to go next
and totally spaced out...
choice_data_list: Yeah. Thank you for doing your best.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Trainer says so, but I know I could have done better...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Next time... next time for sure!
I'll make sure Trainer has a blast!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She said she was planning out today's schedule until late last night,
so she must be exhausted.
I decided to let her sleep a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Nn...
choice_data_list: Craft, should we head back soon?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Huh... Why is it evening already...?
D-Don't tell me I—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaa... No way...!
Falling asleep of all things! Stupid, stupid me!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even so... ugh...
I deeply regret it...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely make up for this mistake...
on our next outing!
